title: Rockstar Games and West Coast Customs Created a Real Car from GTA 6 And Are Selling it For $1.3 Million
summary: Rockstar Games and West Coast Customs teamed up to build real versions of GTA 6's cars... and you can buy one of them if you have $1.3 million lying around.

By Cade Onder Updated : Nov 9, 2026 9:53pm UTC Add IGN on Google 0 2 Rockstar Games and West Coast Customs teamed up to build real versions of GTA 6's cars... and you can buy one of them if you have $1.3 million lying around. UK retailer Selfridges is selling a bunch of GTA 6 merchandise in collaboration with Rockstar Games, including a very expensive varsity jacket. However, the big-ticket item has managed to fly under the radar: one lucky fan has the opportunity to purchase a custom Grotti Cheetah, one of the cars from the GTA series. The vehicle was designed by Rockstar and West Coast Customs and is based on the Ferrari Testarossa, as seen driven by Sonny Crockett in Miami Vice back in the day. If you want it and have £1 million, you can reach out to Selfridges via their personal shopping page. Here’s your chance to own a part of automotive & gaming history! We’re incredibly proud to have partnered with Rockstar Games® to bring the custom in-game Grotti Cheetah from ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ to life. See the full details: https://t.co/kakQSnoh96 https://t.co/2CkYUtjEqF — West Coast Customs (@officialwcc) November 9, 2026 The car is on display in their London store right now. It was previously seen zooming around Miami with a convoy of other GTA 6-inspired vehicles in October and early November. It's hard to imagine this car not getting sold, given the extreme hype for the game. It wouldn't be surprising if a wealthy influencer or content creator made an attempt to snag it, but we'll just have to see who the lucky buyer ends up being. We're officially just a week and a half away from GTA 6's launch, and pre-loading has officially begun in some parts of the world . The game will be available to download globally by tomorrow, allowing players the chance to load all 212 GBs before the big day. Some fans are using this as an opportunity to data mine the game, leading to a few interesting discoveries about certain graphical options/features and potential references for a future online mode. There are rumors that a PC version may launch early next year , but Rockstar Games has yet to confirm this. It's possible that the developer will hold this reveal until it's right around the corner, but there could also be a surprise announcement at The Game Awards. And while Rockstar isn't one to make big announcements at showcase events, it did announce the PS4 version of GTA 5 at E3 2014 and the PS5 version during a PlayStation State of Play. GTA 6 Launch Screenshots View 39 Images Rockstar Games' parent company, Take-Two Interactive, also just confirmed that pre-orders for GTA 6 are "far in excess" of its expectations. As of right now, no hard numbers have been shared, but you can probably expect some kind of victory lap and gloating following the game's opening weekend. GTA 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5. Cade Onder Freelance Writer X Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team.
